• 3-in-1 Foldable & Portable Design: Compact and foldable, this charging station is perfect for travel or daily use. It folds to the size of your phone, eliminating the need for multiple chargers and tangled cords. Easily fits in your pocket or bag, making it a must-have for international travel.
  • Magnetic Wireless Charging: Equipped with strong magnetic adsorption, it securely holds your iPhone 12 -17Series, and Apple Watch in place. Charges through magnetic cases (up to 3mm thick) without needing to remove them, ensuring a seamless charging experience.
  • Wide Compatibility for Apple & Samsung Devices: Designed for Apple and Samsung users, it supports iPhone 17~12 Series, Apple Watch Series 11/10/9/8/7/6/5/4/3/2/SE/Ultra 2 (DO NOT support for Samsung Watch), AirPods Pro3/ 4th( with ANC)/Pro/Pro2/3/2 (wireless versions only), and Samsung Galaxy Buds2 Pro/Buds2/Buds Pro/Buds Live/Buds+. 

Charge multiple devices simultaneously with just one cable.

  • Fast & Efficient Charging: Offers fast charging with 7.5W for iPhone, 10W for Samsung phone, 5W Max for AirPods & Samsung Buds(wireless versions only) , and 2.5W for Apple Watch. Use a QC3.0 fast charger (9V/2A) for optimal performance. Fully charge your devices in 2-3 hours while enjoying hands-free use.
  • Safe & Reliable Charging: Built-in smart chips provide over-current, over-voltage, short-circuit, and over-heat protection. The magnetic isolation sheet ensures no radiation, making it safe for everyone, including children and the elderly.

detail_text: Anvers Qi2 25W Magnetic Wireless Charger Meet Anvers Qi2 25W Magnetic Wireless Charger — a slim, powerful and travel-ready wireless charging pad designed for faster magnetic charging, safer power delivery and everyday convenience. Built with Qi2 wireless charging technology, this charger supports up to 25W ultra-fast magnetic wireless charging for compatible devices. Simply place your phone onto the charging pad and the strong magnetic alignment helps lock it into position for stable, efficient and cable-free charging. Compared with ordinary 15W wireless chargers, Anvers 25W magnetic wireless charger is designed to deliver faster charging performance for selected compatible devices. Internal lab test data shows iPhone 17 Pro Max can charge from 0% to 50% in approximately 30 minutes when used with a suitable 30W or higher power adapter. Actual charging speed may vary depending on device model, system version, adapter output, battery level, temperature and usage environment. Designed for the latest iPhone 17 and iOS 26 charging needs, this charger supports up to 25W wireless charging for compatible iPhone 17 / 16 series models. It also supports up to 15W wireless charging for iPhone 16 / 15 / 14 / 13 / 12 series and selected compatible Android smartphones, and up to 5W wireless charging for compatible wireless earbuds. The strong magnetic alignment makes charging easier and more stable. With 360° precise magnetic positioning, your phone can align quickly and stay securely in place while charging. You can still use your phone for browsing, messaging, video calls or watching content while charging. Anvers wireless charger is designed with multiple safety protections for daily peace of mind. product.highlights:
• 【Mag-Safe 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Stand】 Mag Safe Charger 3 in 1 makes fast charging safe and easy. The built-in super strong magnet makes alignment instantly and precisely, just 1 second to achieve lightning fast wireless charging. The iphone magsafe charger can hold your iphone horizontally and vertically, or in any directions. 

  • 【Wireless Charging Station for Multiple Devices】Our magsafe charger stand provides 3 parts to charging your iphone, Apple Watch, AirPods at the same time. Charging three devices simultaneously, and no interfere with each other. Say goodbye to messy desktop and enjoy your life. The fast wireless charging station compatible with iPhone 16，15,14 ,13,12 Pro Max/Pro/Mini/Plus, Apple Watch series Ultra,10/9/8/7/SE/6/5/4/3/2/1，Airpods 2/3/4/Pro.

  • 【Fast Wireless Charger for iPhone】The iPhone Mag-Safe charger has passed hundreds of tests in our laboratory. It takes 3 hours to fully charge the iphone from 0 to 100, and some of them take 3.5 hours. (Depends on battery condition and and the ambient temperature). It is highly recommended to charge without a case or use a case with Mag-Safe. Supporting fast magnetic charging for iphone (non-magnetic phone case should be less than 3mm) and apple watch.

  • 【Foldable and Portable Magnetic Charger】Our Wireless Charging Pad is foldable in the iphone and apple watch part, which is extremely convenient for travel. Pull up the panel of the iphone magnetic charging pad from the bulge, you can adjust the angle of the panel about 110°. Push up the part of the Apple Watch charger part from the bottom until it stands upright. 2 angles adjustable.
